description: Read one day of a log (default: today's event log) with filters: level (error | info | debug - 4.x event log lines start with E/I/D), contains (text), since / until (HH:MM), tail (last N matching lines, default 150; 0 = all). date = YYYY-MM-DD, YYMMDD, today or yesterday; or give path (e.g. /ev_log/e_261025.csv). vol: q | s (default: the controller's own lookup, internal flash first). Editor/admin level.

vol.description: q = internal flash (GIGA/Opta default), s = SD card (the only volume on a Due)

name: myio_log
title: Read a log
